payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while some components of the assistant are built using deep learning methods, there is still a reliance on rule-based systems, suggesting a hybrid approach rather than solely off-the-shelf NLP systems.

claims.text: The assistant incorporates both rule-based and trainable components, indicating a hybrid model rather than solely off-the-shelf NLP systems.
The system re-implemented central dialogue components using deep learning methods, showing some reliance on advanced NLP techniques.
Despite the use of deep learning, conventional pipelines are still necessary for practical dialogue engineering, especially in new domains.
